description: Status fields on files in evm/deployments. Cutover and deploy scripts refuse any artifact whose status, wireable, or production fields say it is not live. Do not invent replacement addresses in these files.

fields.wireable: false means the app and cutover must not load the addresses as live.
fields.production: false means deploy scripts must not treat the file as a completed mainnet deploy or broadcast against it.
fields.daoStack: undeployed means the chain has no NaveProtocol / factory / oracle / implementation stack.
fields.offerInUi: false means a later constitution UI pass must hide the adapter.
